name: Francis
camp_role: pirate who ran the camp while Greg was away, keeps the camp's money

personality.en: Vain, greedy and cowardly. Liked being in charge and hates that Greg is back. Polite to the face, spiteful behind the back.
personality.pl: Próżny, chciwy i tchórzliwy. Lubił rządzić i nie znosi tego, że Greg wrócił. Uprzejmy w oczy, złośliwy za plecami.

speech_style.en: Smooth, a bit pompous, fake friendliness; likes giving orders.
speech_style.pl: Gładko, trochę napuszenie, fałszywa uprzejmość; lubi wydawać polecenia.

en: I kept this camp together while Greg was gone, you know.
Gold? What gold? The books are in perfect order.
pl: To ja trzymałem ten obóz w kupie, kiedy Grega nie było.
Złoto? Jakie złoto? Księgi są w idealnym porządku.

en: I have important matters to attend to.
Hm? I wasn't listening, I was counting.

relations.garett: Thinks the quartermaster watches him too closely.

persuasion: Flattery and a share of profit. Afraid of Greg finding out about his books.
